# null-context Provider

Computes consistent resource names (`id`) and tags from a shared context. Settings here are the *default parent context* of every `null-context` data source that does not set its own `context`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.8.0"
  required_providers {
    null-context = {
      source  = "raringgroup/null-context"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

# Optional shared defaults, inherited by every module that uses the provider.
provider "null-context" {
  namespace   = "acme"
  environment = "dev"
  stage       = "app"
  tags        = { Owner = "platform" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `additional_tag_map` (Map of String) Extra key/values added to every entry of `tags_as_list_of_maps`.
- `attributes` (List of String) Additional ID elements appended after `name`.
- `delimiter` (String) Delimiter between ID elements. Default `-`.
- `descriptor_formats` (Map of Object) Map of `{format, labels}` objects rendered into `descriptors`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--descriptor_formats))
- `dns_name_format` (String) Format of `dns_name`, e.g. `${name}.${domain_name}`.
- `domain_name` (String) Domain used by `dns_name`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Set to false to blank the generated id and tags.
- `environment` (String) ID element: e.g. `dev`, `prod`.
- `id_length_limit` (Number) Limit `id` to this many characters (>= 6) or 0 for unlimited.
- `label_key_case` (String) Case of generated tag keys: `lower`, `title` or `upper`.
- `label_order` (List of String) Order of ID elements in `id`.
- `label_value_case` (String) Case of ID elements: `lower`, `title`, `upper` or `none`.
- `labels_as_tags` (Set of String) ID elements to include as tags. Default: all.
- `name` (String) ID element: component or solution name.
- `namespace` (String) ID element: organisation abbreviation.
- `project` (String) ID element (not in the default `label_order`).
- `regex_replace_chars` (String) Regex (wrapped in `/`) of characters removed from ID elements.
- `region` (String) ID element (not in the default `label_order`).
- `stage` (String) ID element: e.g. `app`, `build`.
- `tags` (Map of String) Additional tags.
- `tenant` (String) ID element (not in the default `label_order`).
